summary: Build strategic HR advisory skills, stakeholder influence, and workforce analytics. Train with practical tools and executive-ready outputs.
lede: HR business partnering uses business context, workforce evidence and consulting methods to connect people priorities with business needs. For HR and adjacent people professionals, this course develops practical ways to diagnose workforce issues, interpret dashboards and talent metrics, build stakeholder influence plans, and present evidence-based recommendations and action plans for leaders.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work inside HR or adjacent people functions and need stronger advisory credibility in live business conversations.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in HR, talent management, people operations, or a related advisory role. Prior exposure to workforce metrics, basic financial statements, or HR dashboards will help, but no coding is required. This course is best suited to professionals who already support managers or business units and want to strengthen HR business partnering and strategic advisory capability at an intermediate level.
